images.title: Three more than a multiple of 5
images.purpose: Shows that numbers leaving remainder 3 on division by 5 sit 3 steps after each multiple of 5, giving 5k + 3.
images.composition: Plain white background, lots of empty space around the main object, no scenery, no characters, no extra text. One long number line across the centre with tall ticks at multiples of 5 and dots 3 steps after each.
images.exact_structure: A horizontal number line from 0 to 25 with 26 short ticks, one per whole number. The ticks at 0, 5, 10, 15, 20 and 25 are taller and teal (#0072B2), with no numerals. Five reddish purple (#CC79A7) dots sit on the line at 3, 8, 13, 18 and 23, each with its numeral under it. One small amber (#E69F00) bracket above the line spans from the tall tick at 15 to the dot at 18 and carries the label +3. Above the middle of the line, the label 5k + 3. Nothing else in the frame.
rejection: any count of objects, cells, ticks or rows that differs from the numbers stated in the spec
any text beyond the listed visible text, or any listed text misspelled or altered
any board name, publisher name, book title, page number or curriculum branding anywhere in the frame
a hyphen used in place of a minus sign on any labelled number
images.takeaway: Each number with remainder 3 is a multiple of 5 plus 3, so all of them are 5k + 3.
images.description: Shows that numbers leaving remainder 3 on division by 5 sit 3 steps after each multiple of 5, giving 5k + 3.

image_decisions.why: A number line with the multiples of 5 marked shows the remainder as a fixed step of 3, the meaning of 5k + 3.
